objetivos: Programaria's mission is to empower girls and women through technology and programming. for a girl, the challenge of programming begins even before she tries to learn. there is a lack of examples to inspire her and a surfeit of prejudices and stereotypes that discourage and reinforce the idea that technology is a male field. it is not a lack of interest or ability, programaria believes that it is necessary to review these cultural narratives that say what women can and cannot do, and to offer tools and opportunities for them to learn. our activities are based on three pillars of action: inspire, debate and learn. besides showing real examples of women and projects in order to inspire women to feel motivated and confident to explore the technology fields and also to demystify the programming universe by showing its opportunities, we encourage the debate about the lack of representation of women in the field, qualifying the discussion about why women are a minority in these areas and the hostile environment they often encounter. finally, we promote opportunities to learn programming in a safe and friendly environment, composed only of women.

nome: Gender approach in the National Cybersecurity Policy of Chile
objetivos: 1) The State must start by identifying, through periodic studies and surveys, the main risks, threats and shortcomings suffered by women in Chile in the face of the development and use of cyberspace. For such purposes, they must include the indicators for the development of the gender perspective in cybersecurity, identifying the origin of the shortage of women dedicated to cybersecurity in Chile. 2) The State must prevent the argument of national security from being an excuse for state and municipal authorities to execute disproportionate security measures to the detriment of the fundamental rights of citizens and specifically of women. 3) The State and society in general should direct their efforts to encourage girls and adolescents to study careers related to cybersecurity. 4) Finally, the body in charge of personal data protection must grant efficiency and effectiveness to the new regulations issued on data protection, for which it must consider the gender approach when issuing its reports, guidelines and decisions.

detalhes: A presença de professoras e palestrantes mulheres aumenta significativamente a representação e a escolha de carreira em STEM, gerando o efeito 'eu posso ser ela'.
texto: País/Contexto: América Latina. Categoria: Estatística - Soluções. Tópico/Nome: Role Models (Modelos Femininos). Detalhes: A presença de professoras e palestrantes mulheres aumenta significativamente a representação e a escolha de carreira em STEM, gerando o efeito 'eu posso ser ela'.

detalhes: A escola é vista como uma instituição que classifica diferenças. Estratégias de ensino muitas vezes limitam expectativas para meninas, levando-as a crer que exatas 'é coisa de menino'.
texto: País/Contexto: Brasil e México. Categoria: Estatística / Diagnóstico. Tópico/Nome: Estereótipos na Escola. Detalhes: A escola é vista como uma instituição que classifica diferenças. nome: Policy Change on Questions Skipped (Mudança em Testes)
detalhes: Remoção de penalidades por respostas erradas em testes competitivos. O estudo mostrou que isso reduz a brecha de gênero nas notas, pois mulheres tendiam a pular mais questões por aversão ao risco da penalidade.
